vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Residual DSEM roadmap}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

RDSEM places dynamic relations on residual processes, distinct from lagging the
observed outcome. DSEMr records residual-dynamic intent separately in the common
representation so it cannot be silently treated as ordinary DSEM.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
model <- dsem_model("y ~ residual(lag(y, 1))", time = "time")
```

This syntax and its estimator will remain disabled until the published RDSEM
equations, scripts, and simulations have machine-readable parity records.
